title: Second-Home Add-On to the Rural Home Loans Escrow Waiver Fee Rate
content:
Pricing note for Rural Home Loans: an occupancy add-on is added to the escrow waiver fee rate.

## Rule

An occupancy add-on is added to the fee rate: 0.125 percentage points for a second home financed fewer than 36 months ago, 0.0625 points for a second home financed 36 months ago or more, and nothing for a primary residence. The fee rate with the add-on is applied once to the amount the fee is figured on.

| Occupancy on the loan record | Months since financing | Add-on |
|---|---|---|
| second home | fewer than 36 | 0.125 percentage points |
| second home | 36 or more | 0.0625 percentage points |
| primary residence | any | none |

Months since financing are whole months from the loan's opening date on the loan record to today, a month being completed on the same day of the month as the opening date.

## Worked figures (hypothetical inputs)

- A second home financed 35 months ago with a fee rate of 0.35 percent: 0.35 plus 0.125 gives 0.475 percent.
- The same home at 36 months: 0.35 plus 0.0625 gives 0.4125 percent.
- A primary residence: the fee rate stands at 0.35 percent.
